versions.changelog:
opc-live-compliance v1.0.0

- Initial release with full alignment to latest 618 e-commerce compliance regulations.
- Provides mandatory AI content labeling guides for live streaming scenarios.
- Real-time prohibited words filtering and risk grading system included.
- Checklist and workflow for pre-, during-, and post-live compliance.
- Compliant script templates for various live commerce scenarios.
- Integration recommendations for common compliance and monitoring tools.
